metric: Pooled own-vs-foreign AUROC with half ties; higher is better. No per-event accept/reject threshold. Separate six other-video new-reader cases from five ready clipped development cases; never pool them.
bootstrap: Paired whole-video resampling with replacement. Report number of resamples with both classes and discarded absent-class draws. With one foreign case or one own case, narrow empirical intervals do NOT establish generalization.
criteria: Apply original three criteria. Criterion2 requires strict gain on new six-case other-video group, not on reused development cases. The absent independent clipped group is a coverage limitation. Criterion3 is descriptive point superiority over both matched34controls, with uncertainty explicitly reported.
